name: Tome of Administration
firstRoundText: Gain 2 command tokens and purge 1 command token from your reinforcements.
text: Spend 1 command token and 1 influence to add 2 command tokens to your reinforcements.

name: Tome of Negotiation
firstRoundText: At the end of your turn, you may gain control of 1 unowned, non-Mecatol Rex planet adjacent to a planet you control and place 1 infantry on it.
text: Place 1 command token from each other player's reinforcements in a system containing a non-home, non-Mecatol Rex planet you control.

name: Tome of Intrigue
firstRoundText: Draw 4 action cards, give 1 to another player, then discard 2 action cards.
text: Discard up to 3 action cards and draw that many plus 1.

name: Tome of Industrialization
firstRoundText: Twice this round, when you would explore a planet, you may instead place 1 PDS on it.
text: Exhaust 1 planet you control to place 1 structure on it, then place 1 PDS on a planet you control.

name: Tome of Mercantilism
firstRoundText: This round, you may make transactions with players who are not your neighbor. Gain 2 trade goods.
text: Increase your commodity value by 1 and gain 1 trade good for each neighbor you have. Each of your neighbors gains 1 trade good.

name: Tome of Enmity
firstRoundText: Place up to 3 units with a combined cost of 3 or less in your home system or systems adjacent to it.
text: Produce up to 4 units in systems containing your ships, reducing their combined cost by 2.

name: Tome of Experimentation
firstRoundText: Research 1 non-faction technology, then purge 1 technology you own.
text: Spend 4 resources to research a technology whose color you own 3 other technologies in.

name: Tome of Victory
firstRoundText: Unlock your breakthrough and put the fracture into play.
text: Draw 1 secret objective, then discard all but 1 of your secret objectives.
